description: This file defines the Application class within the Opencart admin startup controllers. It initializes core components such as URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, and cart by setting them in the registry, primarily during the index method execution.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing core components during application startup in the admin panel of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes various core services (URL, customer, currency, tax, weight, length, cart) by setting respective objects into the registry.
